create_image_generation_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint that generates images from text prompts via the LiteLLM proxy
create_image_edit_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint that edits images using uploaded files and optional masks via the LiteLLM proxy
convert_uploadfile_to_bytesio: convert a FastAPI UploadFile into a BytesIO buffer with the original filename set
batch_convert_uploadfiles_to_bytesio: batch convert a list of FastAPI UploadFiles into a list of BytesIO buffers
route_image_generation_request: route an image generation request through the LiteLLM proxy router with guardrails and logging hooks
